label: class_d_06_language_01
text: My dear friends! How ARE you all today? I hope\nyou are doing MARVELOUSLY well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_02
text: It’s time for another of Salvatore’s Language\nLessons! Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_yes_01
text: Yes!

label: class_d_06_yes_02
text: Oui!

label: class_d_06_language_03
text: I would expect no less from my excellent friends!\nEven your replies to my questions are excellent![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_04
text: Aujourd’hui—today—we will once again be\nfocusing on listening![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_05
text: Vas-y—go for it, my assistant! Pika pi, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_poke_01
text: Pikachu!

label: class_d_06_language_06
text: As you may remember from our last class,\nthe same Pokémon’s cries may sound different\r\ndepending on what it wants to say![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_07
text: Aujourd’hui—today, that is—we will be learning\nmore about the language used by Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_08
text: Je t’en prie—if you would be so kind, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_poke_02
text: Pikaaa...

label: class_d_06_language_09
text: Hmmm! That sounds a little bleak, doesn’t it? Its\nvoice seems a little lower pitched, too![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_10
text: What emotion do you suppose Pikachu was\ntrying to convey just now?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_select_01
text: Happiness

label: class_d_06_select_02
text: Sadness

label: class_d_06_select_03
text: Surprise

label: class_d_06_select_04
text: Say it again, Pikachu!

label: class_d_06_language_14
text: When Pikachu says...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_poke_03
text: Pikaaa...

label: class_d_06_language_15
text: It’s expressing sadness! Kind of makes you want\nto cry, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_16
text: That’s right—I had my little Pikachu cry as if it\nwas...crying! Haha! Funny joke, right?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_17
text: Don’t you think it did a great job? Give Pikachu\na round of applause, everyone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_popup_01
text: *clapping*

label: class_d_06_language_18
text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one of my wise words of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_19
text: If you hear one of your Pokémon making sad\nnoises like this one, you should treat them with\r\neven more kindness than usual.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_20
text: Well, you probably already knew that, though! A\npiece of cake for you all, I’m sure![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_21
text: Of course, this goes for your classmates and\nothers as well![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_22
text: Friends should support each other in times of\nsadness! I truly hope that you all can have smiles\r\non your faces all the time, my friends![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_06_language_23
text: Our prochain cours—next lesson, that is—will be\nour final lesson together! I hope you’re ready for\r\nthe climactic finale! Adios! Mata ne![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
